column1: # Agent-health presentation manifest — phase-4 fixed input (criterion 1)
# ============ WHAT THIS IS, AND WHAT IT IS NOT ============
# A COMMITMENT, NOT A RATIFICATION. These are the bytes the successor CURRENTLY
# EMITS for the per-agent health cell. They are not ratified layout, and this
# file does not make them so. src/listing.rs states in its own module docs that
# the tabular layout is provisional and unratified, and that layout bytes are a
# seat decision INFORMED BY PARITY EVIDENCE. Phase 4 is that evidence. So a
# commitment about current bytes must never be read as pre-empting a later
# ratification of required bytes -- a reader who finds a pinned byte map with no
# such sentence reads it as ratified layout, and phase 4 has then quietly
# decided the thing it exists to inform.
# THE PIN MOVES WITH THE RENDERER. Any change to src/listing.rs affecting the
# locator or the tokens invalidates this manifest. derived_from_blob_sha1 is how
# that is checked, and it is content-addressed: the commit is context, the blob
# is the pin.
# ============ SCOPE OF THE MEASUREMENT ============
# Domain identification is MEASURED CLEAN over the pinned corpus and the
# controlled harness rosters, FOR THIS RUN ONLY. That is NOT a product-wide row
# grammar, and NOT a guarantee about input nobody has produced yet. An absent
# specimen proves the case did not arise; it never proves the case cannot arise.
# The defects the measurement bounds (D1, D2, D3 below) remain real successor
# defects, filed independently of whether this corpus reaches them.
# Every denominator below is non-zero, deliberately: a bound measured over an
# empty population would be vacuous rather than clean, and would report absence
# of evidence as evidence of a property.
# Authored from the intentional renderer grammar and token choices, read from
# the pinned blob via `git show` rather than from a working tree. NEVER
# inferred, repaired, or regenerated from frozen output, successor captures,
# comparator behaviour, obligation results, or a failed comparison. The
# independence boundary is TEMPORAL: this is committed before any
# comparison-time evidence exists.
# \t means the single byte U+0009 and \n the single byte U+000A, never a
# backslash followed by a letter. Fields in THIS file are themselves separated
# by one U+0009. Lines beginning with # are comments. A row whose key is
# SECTION is a heading, not data.
# ============ WHY THE LOCATOR INDEXES FROM THE END ============
# A tab inside the agent reference would add fields at the FRONT of the row, so
# a positive index drifts onto the wrong span while a negative one still lands.
# That is robustness by construction rather than by precondition, and it is
# preferred even though D1 measures clean. The locator never inspects the token
# it locates (that would be circular -- it would prove only that a token is
# where a token is), never reads the adjacent state or reason value, never
# consults captured successor output, and never relies on neighbour width.
# ============ WHY alive IS PINNED THOUGH UNREACHABLE ============
# No product predicate can currently produce alive: SC-017p grants it only on an
# observation that "positively recognizes its agent process as live", and no
# ratified row defines that predicate. This manifest describes the total
# PRESENTATION DOMAIN, not liveness reachability, and criterion 8 feeds all
# three values synthetically through the real presentation boundary.
